title: The Vault
statement: Vaulted works, not for sale for at least 10 years. Passed down through the MintFace bloodline.
intent: Works vaulted, not for sale for at least ten years. Passed down through the MintFace bloodline to the next generation. Patrimora is the same idea in Latin ... patri, what is handed down, and mora, delay. A heritage postponed but inevitable.
